name: Condensed milk
description: Milk boiled down with sugar until it pours like syrup.

tcm.note: Long reduction concentrates and warms; sweet and damp-forming.

ayurveda.note: Cooked down and heavily sweetened — the cooking is what turns milk's shita.

unani.note: Garam by preparation rather than by ingredient.

histamine.note: Heat-treated and sugar-preserved; low in itself.

guna.note: Fresh dairy is sattvic; the reading changes once it sours or ages.
